question: Do the focused migration tests and compatibility behavior provide enough assurance to ship the schema-4-to-6 and portable-store upgrade on this exact head?
rationale: Automated review finds no concrete defect, but green CI cannot decide whether the persistent-data migration and default fallback behavior meet the maintainers' intended upgrade contract.

options.title: Approve the upgrade contract
